# Generated by tools/patch_day/lr_reopen_unique_decisions.py (Lux Renata, 2026-11-22). Edit the generator, not this file.
# When a formed realm is destroyed, its one-time formation decision opens again (flag taken off
# unavailable_unique_decisions), once none of the titles that decision formed has a holder.

on_title_destroyed = {
	on_actions = { LR_reopen_unique_decisions_on_title_destroyed }
}

					limit = { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = unavailable_unique_decisions target = flag:flag_lux_peithonid_founded } NOT = { exists = title:e_peithonid_empire.holder } }
					remove_list_global_variable = { name = unavailable_unique_decisions target = flag:flag_lux_peithonid_founded }
				}
			}
			title:k_portugal = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = unavailable_unique_decisions target = flag:form_portugal_decision } }
					remove_list_global_variable = { name = unavailable_unique_decisions target = flag:form_portugal_decision }
				}
			}
			title:k_siam = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = unavailable_unique_decisions target = flag:flag_created_siam_kingdom } }
					remove_list_global_variable = { name = unavailable_unique_decisions target = flag:flag_created_siam_kingdom }
				}
			}
			title:k_switzerland = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = unavailable_unique_decisions target = flag:flag_formed_switzerland_kingdom } }
					remove_list_global_variable = { name = unavailable_unique_decisions target = flag:flag_formed_switzerland_kingdom }
				}
			}
			title:k_toledo = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = unavailable_unique_decisions target = flag:form_toledo_decision } }
					remove_list_global_variable = { name = unavailable_unique_decisions target = flag:form_toledo_decision }
				}
			}
			title:k_visigoths = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = unavailable_unique_decisions target = flag:flag_formed_kingdom_of_aragon } }
					remove_list_global_variable = { name = unavailable_unique_decisions target = flag:flag_formed_kingdom_of_aragon }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
